title: Record South Georgia/South Sandwich dispute semantics and review one-child island tiers

body:
2026-10-05: Follow-up from #402's read-only source/semantic packet. Do not change location geometry, IDs, the fixed South American Atlantic Islands macro member set, or any regional approval/import gate.

## Scope
Correct the disputed current-administration/reference annotation for `atlas:coverage:SGS+00?` so it preserves the UK-administered/separate-Overseas-Territory reference while recording Argentina's claim to South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands and retaining uncertainty. Do not state a sovereignty adjudication. Review the adjacent same-name, one-child area/province/location tiers for both `atlas:coverage:SGS+00?` and `FLK-5152`; implement only an ID-preserving change if the accepted geographic role is independently supported. Coordinate shared parent changes with #401.

Primary sources and findings: #402 evidence packet, UK SI 1985/449 §§2–3, GSGSSI official territorial/about pages, Argentina official claim, UN Treaty Collection depositary note, pinned Natural Earth 2022 record. #402 notes the GSGSSI byte-hash retrieval limitation and its precise scope. No regional geometry or publication approval is requested.

Acceptance: substantive source and hierarchy review; migration preserves stable IDs and existing claims/evidence; tests/evidence bind to exact baseline pins and distinguish administration from sovereignty; engineering follow-up records any unresolved tier decision. One PR, maximum.
